title: Verify document, undo, migration, and source-link invariants
summary: Create a repository-owned assurance plan for internal visual product, design, diagram, and proposal workspace. Make it continuously knowable whether this claim is correct: Board documents, commands, undo and redo, source references, assets, migrations, proposals, and recovery remain deterministic and non-destructive.
acceptance_criteria: Document the critical product claim: Board documents, commands, undo and redo, source references, assets, migrations, proposals, and recovery remain deterministic and non-destructive.
Map the claim to repository role `internal visual product, design, diagram, and proposal workspace` and exclude irrelevant portfolio-wide requirements.
Assign stable IDs to critical invariants, requirements, and user-visible claims.
Identify code, data, schema, configuration, service, hardware, and content owners for every invariant.
Classify every invariant by failure impact and required verification risk level.
Map each invariant to proportionate static, unit, integration, migration, UI, performance, accessibility, privacy, security, hardware, or runtime evidence.
Add negative, malformed-input, interruption, stale-data, permission-denied, and recovery scenarios for the highest risks.
Record whether evidence is synthetic, fixture-backed, local, simulator, device, hardware, staged, or production-like.
Define evidence invalidation triggers for source, dependency, schema, environment, configuration, toolchain, and requirement changes.
Never infer passing state from missing, not-run, blocked, unavailable, or stale evidence.
Connect warning, lint, build, test, and performance failures to assurance state without suppression.
Define independent review requirements proportionate to risk.
Define rollback, restore, compensation, or safe-stop evidence for harmful failure.
Publish a machine-readable verification plan and coverage graph owned by this repository.
Represent monetization posture `internal-now-optional-commercialization-later` only where it adds real entitlement, billing, ad, marketplace, or release invariants.
Refresh repository status with assurance gaps and evidence freshness.
Run the strongest practical repository-native gates and record unavailable runtime proof honestly.

agent_notes: Non-scope: do not implement unrelated product features, cross-app integrations, releases, deployments, or destructive operations.
